deletionRequests.title: Deletion requests

complete.title: Erase this record
complete.body: This deletes the patient's profile and every clinical record and report file behind it. It cannot be undone.
complete.account: It does not close their sign-in account — do that separately in the patient gateway.

reject.title: Refuse this request
reject.body: A legal hold, an open investigation, or a request that is plainly about somebody else's account.
reject.reasonLabel: Why — the patient is owed this
